entry_rule: First valid NSE trading day strictly after the anchor, maximum 5 calendar days later.
outcome_rule: Latest valid NSE trading day on or before the outcome target, maximum 5 calendar days earlier.
sampling: SHA256 outcome-blind deterministic sample from anchor-date NSE EQ operating-company securities; INF-prefixed fund/ETF ISINs are excluded.
score_scope: Technical Accumulation historical partial slice only; no claim that this is the complete 100-point RK-MIS score.

excluded_feature.reason: The post-2019 Base Quality candidate failed the untouched 2021 holdout and is not permitted in this replay.

score_normalization: Earned points are divided by the 80 evidenced feature-weight units above and expressed on a 0-100 technical-partial scale. Approved feature bands are read directly from config/rk_mie_scoring.json.
technical_replay_grade: At least 200 corporate-action-safe daily observations and all four included feature values available before the anchor.
corporate_action_rule: Pre-anchor price history and entry price are adjusted only through deterministic split/bonus/consolidation/fully-resolved-rights factors. A material unresolved action makes the affected replay unsafe rather than guessed.
outcome_isolation: Technical scores and their SHA-256 snapshot are frozen before entry/outcome prices are acquired and joined.
